eps.ov: The girls are forced to try out a new virtual reality game created by Akashi.

eps.t: The Power of Healing is Important.
eps.ov: The girls experience Charybdis' healing skills, so that Dido can master them and boost her self-esteem.

eps.t: So, This is the World of Adults...
eps.ov: The girls want to look a bit more grown-up. Algérie, Zara and Pola arrive to help them with fashion.
Royal Fortune and Golden Hind introduce the girls to the concept of fighting for treasure.

eps.t: So In Other Words, Girl Power?
eps.ov: The girls and Z46 work with Bremerton to achieve peak girl power - whatever that means.
Laffey will determine whether Suruga and Shimakaze are ready to show their new bunny outfits to the commander.

eps.t: The Godlike Way to Spend a Holiday.
eps.ov: The girls head out to the forest to find a way for the commander to relax.
New secretary Janus meets Jervis, Implacable and the quartet to find out why the commander is late for work.
The girls head to the cafeteria for the daily special, but there isn't enough for everyone.
Prinz Rupprecht and Roon join the girls for some sweets, but they need to clear some obstacles first.

eps.t: I Wish I Didn't Have to Shoot...
eps.ov: Indiana and Pittsburg invite the girls to experience a Western show, complete with tumbleweed and shootouts.

eps.t: Tomorrow Will Probably Be Fun Too.
eps.ov: Akashi releases a batch of hyperactive Meowofficers. The girls must work together to catch them all.
